body: Refreshed with main (202224f0). The only conflict was PROCESS_VERSION, now 22 (renumbers at merge). mcp_work_offset, wcs_index and mcp pass, and clippy is clean. Still a draft, waiting on #945's Hub run and the combo hand check.

Refreshed with main (c8a1bab1): merged the refreshed #1113 (`issue/931-wcs-index-app`, a7179f8b) first, then `upstream/main`. Main was already in through #1113, so the second merge had nothing to do. Head is now 0f34ac74.

Two files conflicted:
- `crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs`, in the `TOOLS` table. Both sides are kept: this PR's index-based `set_work_offset` entry, and main's new `set_raw_stock_only` entry. The rest of the file auto-merged, and it is 323 lines.
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`: this PR had 22 and #1113/main have 18. It is set to 23.

`git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only the #931 stack's files. Tests: app `mcp_work_offset` 4/4, `wcs_index` 4/4, `mcp` 18/18, `recorded_post_streams` 2/2, and post `recorded_streams` 10/10. The ui lib, run from `crates/ui`, passed 564 with 5 ignored and no law_tests failures. Clippy `-D warnings` is clean on ui `--all-targets` and on app `--lib --bins --test '*'`. It ran per target because of #1146: on main the app lib tests don't compile, from `rotary_law_tests.rs:27`, which is missing `neck`. Stays draft.

Refreshed with main (9032da34): parents #945, #1101, #1113 were all still MERGEABLE, so they were left as they are; merged #1113's current head (a7179f8b) - already contained - then main. One conflict: .claude/PROCESS_VERSION (this branch 23, main 20) -> 24. Head 896fc976. Tests: post work_offset_index 9, recorded_streams 10; app wcs_index 4, mcp_work_offset 4, mcp 18, recorded_post_streams 2, sinumerik_work_offsets 2 - all pass; cargo test -p xtask 37/37 (incl. no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app); clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings clean. Stays a draft.

Refreshed with main (6a10c5ad), merged in through the refreshed parent #1113 (a9f8e289). The only conflict was `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`, renumbered to 30: main is on 25, open peers hold 26-29 (#972 28, #1033 29). After that, merging main directly was already up to date. No new Dump literals or streams, and no golden moved. Head 5209b835.

Tests: every camcraft-post suite passes: `work_offset_index` 9, `recorded_streams` 10, all eleven `script_*` suites 9 each. App `wcs_index` 4/4, `mcp` 18/18, `recorded_post_streams` 2/2, `sinumerik_work_offsets` 2/2. UI lib, run from `crates/ui`: 570 passed and 6 failed in the parallel run, all in `law_tests` / `path_lines`. Re-run with `--test-threads=1`, all 68 of those tests pass. Clippy on post, app and ui with `-D warnings` is clean. Mergeable.

Merged main (62a2c93a) to resolve conflicts. One file conflicted: `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` (yours 30 vs main's 29) - kept 30, your bump stands above current main. Nothing else touched; targeted gate: `cargo check -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets` green on the merge commit d97157c2 (test targets included). Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

**Maintainer-side GUI hand check: passed** (the user, macOS arm64 release build of head `d97157c2`, which the build stamp confirms; `simple.camproj` with a first setup created, Tormach 1100MX, 2026-11-12 ~20:30-20:36 PT).
- **Tormach PathPilot post:** the Work offset combo lists 9 entries, `Work offset 1 (G54)` … `Work offset 9 (G59.3)`. Picking 9 shows WCS `G59.3` in the tree, and the status line says `Setup1 WCS posts as G59.3`.
- **Switched to the Fanuc post:** the combo lists 1-6 (G54-G59), then `Work offset 9 - not on this post` alone after them. The tree reads `work offset 9`; it is never silently offset 1.
- **Post with Fanuc + offset 9** (after regenerating the stale op): refused, naming the setup. The message reads `post blocked - setup Setup1 uses work offset 9, but its post Fanuc (built-in) expresses work offsets 1-6 only - pick one of those on the Setups page or use a post with more offsets` and `Nothing was written to simple.nc`.
- **Undo:** goes back to Tormach PathPilot / G59.3. Picking offset 1 on Fanuc leaves a plain 1-6 list.

The owed hand check is done. This PR still shows `conflicts` with main; it stays a draft until its merge-time refresh, then the quick pass flags it ready.
taken by SKULL for the refresh @ d97157c2

Merge-time refresh: merged the freshly pushed parent `issue/931-wcs-index-app` (#1113 @ 2871b646, carrying #1101 @ 3460d7ba and upstream/main 2d15a617) as a647df4b, then `upstream/main` (7bfb1824, which had moved meanwhile) as **9720520e**, the new head. Plain merges, no rebase, no force.

Per-file resolutions, parent merge (a647df4b):
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`: main's 63. By the current rule this PR no longer bumps it; the body now says "Process change: yes" for the skill row.
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`: main's new `set_wcs_circle_centre` / `set_wcs_from_features` rows kept; this slice's `set_work_offset` row replaces the old G54-G59 row.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs` (`TOOLS`): this slice's `set_work_offset` entry kept, with main's `set_program` and `set_setup_post` entries.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs`: main's side (main moved `machine_section` / `wcs_page` out of this file). The slice's only change there, the work-offset label ("the offset this setup posts, as its post names it"), is re-applied in its new home `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page.rs`.
- Follow-through: `set_wcs_from_features` (main's `crates/app/src/mcp/wcs_tools.rs`) now answers `index` and `name` beside `word`, as `set_wcs` does in this slice and the SKILL row says.

upstream/main merge (9720520e):
- `crates/app/src/operation/types/mod.rs`: main's new `wire_edm` exports (`WireSkim`, `SKIMS_MAX`) kept; the `sel` re-export takes the stack's form (no `WCS_SLOTS`, `LEGACY_WCS_NAMES`).
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs`: main's #771 draft assert and this slice's #931 work-offset combo asserts both kept.
- Snapshot PNGs, `CHANGELOG.md`, `RECOMMENDED.md`: main's.

Output check: against the refreshed #1113, the post scripts, `crates/post`, `posting*.rs` differ only by main's own commits (wire-iso / sodick-wire / posting_wire); this slice's only post-side code is display and MCP input parsing in `setup_offsets.rs` (`entry_label`, `parse_index`), which never reaches the stream. The Hub-tested output stands: G54/G59 unchanged, G59.1-G59.3 as tested, offset 10 refused by name.

Gate on 9720520e:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green - post (10 s), app (1515 s), ui (84 s) suites: 3872 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Note: #1101 and #1113 were refreshed against upstream/main 2d15a617; main has since moved to 7bfb1824, and this head carries both.

ready for review (M3/M5)

Merge-time refresh: merged origin/main (b08d73977, includes #1113) into the branch as 494a7c365 (previous head 9720520e). Plain merge, no rebase, no force.

Hand-resolved hunk: one file, `crates/app/src/operation/types/mod.rs`. The conflict was a single blank line between the `wire_edm` re-export and `pub use sel::...`; this branch had the blank, main did not. Kept main's text. No logic and no work-offset code was involved. Everything else merged automatically.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` green (app suites incl. mcp_work_offset and wcs_index, ui suites), 5.5 min, 0 failed.

Not exercised: clippy, the batch tier, the ui lib suites beyond what quick selected, snapshot lanes, GUI hand check on the new head.

Merged under the maintainer's standing answers: "Assume yes on all merges until i say different", "Yes, standing rule" (reviewed feat PRs merge before the cut) and "Merge without screenshots".
Note: this changes how work offsets are listed and set (GUI and MCP `set_work_offset`). Not exercised: the GUI by hand, a user `.cps` post with extended offsets, the release lanes, the Windows arm. Screenshots are owed.
